info.title: gankdat
info.description: UK and EU public registers as clean JSON: company lookup and monitoring, tenders and contract awards, sanctions and exclusions, charities, schools, NHS organisations, care locations, trade marks and licences. One schema across every dataset, from official open-data feeds, with a daily change feed on each register. Connect with the key from your gankdat account.

get.description: uk feed, normalized to one schema. Blind Mode: no applicant personal data. One call returns one page of matching records (25 by default, up to 100) with the total count and the last refresh time, and costs the credits the sources listing states.
